note: Phase 4 closes NOTHING, and says so rather than closing on a recorded differential. It owns 1137 function rows and 2813 data objects; 127 of the function rows are reconstructed with a proof, 1010 are not reconstructed, and no data object is dispositioned. The schema accepts one thing as a closure -- a mutation aimed at the row that the gate catches -- and this phase has no per-row mutation evidence. The ledger is published so that every row the phase owns is accounted for rather than left in no list: before it existed, 3950 rows were owned by a phase with no ledger at all.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: a mutation aimed at this row in a throwaway archive copy, rebuilt, and run against the committed oracle transcript through a registered staged-pair target. This phase has none yet.
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation aimed at the row and caught by a static check rather than a differential. This phase has none yet.

deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: this phase did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. A debt, not an obstruction.
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: the row is reconstructed and carries a recorded proof, but no mutation has been aimed at it. This is the work the phase has left: 127 rows, each needing one mutation and one measured detection.
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: no closure schema lets any phase close a data object, so the data half arrives here by construction.

entry_points: the census rows this phase owns, by rva
